insulator_inspection.inspection_standoff.rule: When inspecting an insulator string, a novice should always keep at least 5 m from the string and never go closer, because closer work takes experience and an untrained pilot risks hitting and breaking something.
conditions: Only an experienced pilot may go closer than 5 m; an apprentice never does.
